hook.en: In 1989 a burst of charged particles from the Sun caused a blackout across Quebec, Canada for about nine hours. Weather in space can affect life on Earth.
hook.bm: Pada 1989, letusan zarah bercas dari Matahari menyebabkan gangguan bekalan elektrik di seluruh Quebec, Kanada selama kira-kira sembilan jam. Cuaca di angkasa boleh menjejaskan kehidupan di Bumi.

bigIdeas.en: The Sun has layers (core, radiative zone, convective zone, photosphere, chromosphere, corona) and is very active.
bigIdeas.bm: Matahari mempunyai lapisan (teras, zon radiasi, zon olakan, fotosfera, kromosfera, korona) dan sangat aktif.

bigIdeas.en: Sunspots, solar flares, prominences, coronal mass ejections and the solar wind send energy and particles into space.
bigIdeas.bm: Tompok matahari, nyalaan suria, prominen, lentingan jisim korona dan angin suria menghantar tenaga dan zarah ke angkasa.

bigIdeas.en: Space weather can disturb satellites, GPS, radio and power grids, and causes auroras near the poles.
bigIdeas.bm: Cuaca angkasa boleh mengganggu satelit, GPS, radio dan grid elektrik, serta menghasilkan aurora berhampiran kutub.

detail.bm: Permukaan yang kelihatan, kira-kira 5 500 °C; tompok matahari

definition.en: Darker, cooler area on the photosphere caused by strong magnetic fields.
definition.bm: Kawasan lebih gelap dan sejuk pada fotosfera akibat medan magnet yang kuat.

definition.en: A sudden, intense burst of radiation from the Sun.
definition.bm: Letusan sinaran yang tiba-tiba dan kuat dari Matahari.

definition.en: Huge cloud of charged particles thrown out from the corona.
definition.bm: Awan besar zarah bercas yang dilontar dari korona.

definition.en: Continuous stream of charged particles from the Sun.
definition.bm: Aliran berterusan zarah bercas dari Matahari.

definition.en: Coloured lights in the sky near the poles when charged particles hit the atmosphere.
definition.bm: Cahaya berwarna di langit berhampiran kutub apabila zarah bercas menghentam atmosfera.

definition.en: Earth's magnetic field region that shields us from much of the solar wind.
definition.bm: Kawasan medan magnet Bumi yang melindungi kita daripada kebanyakan angin suria.

question.en: Why are auroras seen mainly near the North and South Poles?
question.bm: Mengapakah aurora kebanyakannya dilihat berhampiran Kutub Utara dan Kutub Selatan?

steps.en: Charged particles from the Sun are guided by Earth's magnetic field.
steps.bm: Zarah bercas dari Matahari dipandu oleh medan magnet Bumi.

steps.en: The field lines bring them into the atmosphere near the magnetic poles.
steps.bm: Garis medan membawanya masuk ke atmosfera berhampiran kutub magnet.

steps.en: They collide with gas particles, which give off coloured light.
steps.bm: Zarah itu berlanggar dengan zarah gas, yang memancarkan cahaya berwarna.

answer.en: Earth's magnetic field channels the particles towards the poles.
answer.bm: Medan magnet Bumi menyalurkan zarah ke arah kutub.

prompt.en: Which layer is the visible surface of the Sun?
prompt.bm: Lapisan manakah permukaan Matahari yang kelihatan?

explanation.en: The photosphere is where sunspots are seen.
explanation.bm: Fotosfera ialah tempat tompok matahari dilihat.

prompt.en: Where does nuclear fusion take place in the Sun?
prompt.bm: Di manakah pelakuran nuklear berlaku dalam Matahari?

explanation.en: Hydrogen nuclei fuse into helium in the core.
explanation.bm: Nukleus hidrogen bercantum menjadi helium dalam teras.

prompt.en: Sunspots appear dark because they are…
prompt.bm: Tompok matahari kelihatan gelap kerana ia…

explanation.en: They are still extremely hot, just cooler than nearby areas.
explanation.bm: Ia masih sangat panas, cuma lebih sejuk daripada kawasan berhampiran.

prompt.en: The continuous stream of charged particles from the Sun is called the solar ______.
prompt.bm: Aliran berterusan zarah bercas dari Matahari dipanggil ______ suria.

explanation.en: The solar wind flows out through the solar system.
explanation.bm: Angin suria mengalir ke seluruh sistem suria.

prompt.en: The number of sunspots rises and falls in a cycle of about…
prompt.bm: Bilangan tompok matahari meningkat dan menurun dalam kitaran kira-kira…

explanation.en: This is the solar cycle.
explanation.bm: Inilah kitaran suria.

prompt.en: Auroras are seen mostly near…
prompt.bm: Aurora kebanyakannya dilihat berhampiran…

explanation.en: Earth's magnetic field guides particles to the poles.
explanation.bm: Medan magnet Bumi memandu zarah ke kutub.

prompt.en: What protects Earth from most of the solar wind?
prompt.bm: Apakah yang melindungi Bumi daripada kebanyakan angin suria?

explanation.en: Earth's magnetic field deflects charged particles.
explanation.bm: Medan magnet Bumi memesongkan zarah bercas.

prompt.en: The outermost layer of the Sun's atmosphere is the…
prompt.bm: Lapisan paling luar atmosfera Matahari ialah…

explanation.en: It is visible during a total solar eclipse.
explanation.bm: Ia kelihatan semasa gerhana matahari penuh.

prompt.en: Arrange the layers of the Sun from the centre outward.
prompt.bm: Susun lapisan Matahari dari pusat ke luar.

explanation.en: The first three are inside; the last three form the solar atmosphere and surface.
explanation.bm: Tiga yang pertama di bahagian dalam; tiga terakhir membentuk permukaan dan atmosfera suria.

prompt.en: Match each solar activity with its description.
prompt.bm: Padankan aktiviti suria dengan huraiannya.

explanation.en: These activities are linked to the Sun's magnetic field.
explanation.bm: Aktiviti ini berkait dengan medan magnet Matahari.

right.en: Darker, cooler patch on the photosphere
right.bm: Tompok lebih gelap dan sejuk pada fotosfera

right.en: Loop of glowing gas from the surface
Huge cloud of charged particles ejected into space
right.bm: Awan besar zarah bercas dilontar ke angkasa

prompt.en: Select ALL effects of a strong solar storm on Earth.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA kesan ribut suria yang kuat ke atas Bumi.

explanation.en: Solar storms do not cause earthquakes.
explanation.bm: Ribut suria tidak menyebabkan gempa bumi.

prompt.en: Why do astronauts need extra protection during a solar storm?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah angkasawan memerlukan perlindungan tambahan semasa ribut suria?

explanation.en: On Earth, the atmosphere and magnetosphere shield us.
explanation.bm: Di Bumi, atmosfera dan magnetosfera melindungi kita.

options.en: They face more harmful radiation outside Earth's protective atmosphere
options.bm: Mereka menghadapi lebih banyak sinaran berbahaya di luar atmosfera Bumi yang melindungi

prompt.en: Space weather is…
prompt.bm: Cuaca angkasa ialah…

explanation.en: It includes the solar wind, flares and CMEs.
explanation.bm: Ia termasuk angin suria, nyalaan dan CME.

options.en: conditions in space caused mainly by the Sun's activity
options.bm: keadaan di angkasa yang disebabkan terutamanya oleh aktiviti Matahari

prompt.en: Approximately how hot is the Sun's core?
prompt.bm: Kira-kira berapakah suhu teras Matahari?

explanation.en: The photosphere is about 5 500 °C.
explanation.bm: Fotosfera kira-kira 5 500 °C.

prompt.en: The region around Earth controlled by its magnetic field is the ______.
prompt.bm: Kawasan di sekeliling Bumi yang dikawal oleh medan magnetnya ialah ______.

explanation.en: It deflects much of the solar wind.
explanation.bm: Ia memesongkan kebanyakan angin suria.

prompt.en: Which agency monitors space weather and space activities for Malaysia?
prompt.bm: Agensi manakah memantau cuaca angkasa dan aktiviti angkasa bagi Malaysia?

explanation.en: MYSA (formerly ANGKASA and MRSA) handles national space matters.
explanation.bm: MYSA (dahulunya ANGKASA dan MRSA) mengendalikan hal ehwal angkasa negara.

options.en: Malaysian Meteorological Department only for rain
options.bm: Jabatan Meteorologi Malaysia hanya untuk hujan

prompt.en: GPS in a car gives a wrong position during a strong solar storm. What is the most likely reason?
prompt.bm: GPS dalam kereta memberi kedudukan salah semasa ribut suria yang kuat. Apakah sebab paling mungkin?

explanation.en: Satellite signals travel through the ionosphere, which solar storms disturb.
explanation.bm: Isyarat satelit melalui ionosfera, yang diganggu oleh ribut suria.

options.en: Charged particles disturb the upper atmosphere, affecting satellite signals
options.bm: Zarah bercas mengganggu atmosfera atas, menjejaskan isyarat satelit

options.en: The car engine is too hot

prompt.en: Scientists count sunspots to forecast space weather. Why is this useful?
prompt.bm: Saintis mengira tompok matahari untuk meramal cuaca angkasa. Mengapakah ini berguna?

explanation.en: Warnings allow satellites to be put in safe mode.
explanation.bm: Amaran membolehkan satelit diletakkan dalam mod selamat.

options.en: More sunspots usually mean more flares and CMEs, so operators can protect satellites and grids
options.bm: Lebih banyak tompok matahari biasanya bermaksud lebih banyak nyalaan dan CME, jadi pengendali boleh melindungi satelit dan grid
Tompok matahari menyebabkan hujan di Malaysia

prompt.en: Why can people in Malaysia rarely see auroras?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah rakyat Malaysia jarang dapat melihat aurora?

explanation.en: Auroras occur mainly in high-latitude regions.
explanation.bm: Aurora berlaku terutamanya di kawasan latitud tinggi.

options.en: Malaysia is near the Equator, far from the magnetic poles where particles enter
options.bm: Malaysia berhampiran Khatulistiwa, jauh dari kutub magnet tempat zarah masuk

options.en: Malaysia has too many clouds every night
options.bm: Malaysia mempunyai terlalu banyak awan setiap malam
Aurora hanya berlaku pada tengah hari

prompt.en: A power company hears a large CME is heading to Earth. What is a sensible action?
prompt.bm: Sebuah syarikat elektrik dimaklumkan bahawa CME besar menuju ke Bumi. Apakah tindakan yang wajar?

explanation.en: Strong geomagnetic storms can damage transformers.
explanation.bm: Ribut geomagnet yang kuat boleh merosakkan transformer.

options.en: Prepare the grid (e.g. reduce load, protect transformers) and monitor closely
options.bm: Bersedia (cth. kurangkan beban, lindungi transformer) dan pantau dengan teliti
Lancarkan lebih banyak satelit dengan segera
